svg.title: Hydraulic Condition Monitoring Digital Twin System Architecture
svg.desc: Animated system pipeline diagram: multi-rate physical sensing (100Hz, 10Hz, 1Hz), ingestion, grey-box physics feature engineering, ONNX supervisory twin, OPC-UA replay server, Health Index gauge sweeping 0.95 to 0.26, and automated ERPNext CMMS work order generation.

g.text: Multi-Rate Sensing (100/10/1 Hz) → Grey-Box Physics → ONNX Inference → CMMS Dispatch
